$comment: Non-secret Cloudflare settings shared by every site Worker. The API token and account ID live only in env vars (CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID).

secretsStore.$comment: TODO: set storeId to the account's Secrets Store ID (`wrangler secrets-store store list --remote`). Every site Worker binds TRACER_FORM_KEY to this one account-level secret.

api.$comment: Cloudflare allows 1,200 API requests per 5 minutes per token and blocks the token for 5 minutes after a 429. 250ms spacing stays under that.

zones.$comment: Cloudflare: at most 25 new zones per 10 minutes; once an account has more than 50 zones, no new zones while more are pending than active.
